steps.path: Type /resume, then click a conversation in the list
steps.headline: The whole right side is now one lightly tinted surface, including around the model and Resume card.
steps.changed: The preview area and the space around the bottom card share one background: your theme's normal background with a small amount of its accent color. No wallpaper image.
steps.measured: Tint is 5% accent mixed into the normal background.
steps.notice: No plain white strip around the model/Resume card, and the preview reads slightly tinted rather than pure white in Light.
steps.risk: On wallpaper themes the preview no longer shows the wallpaper; it is a flat tinted surface.

steps.path: Click Preview on a conversation the assistant found for you
steps.headline: The side-panel preview uses the same light tint instead of the wallpaper.
steps.changed: You approved this surface last round; the only change is the background, which follows your note to drop the wallpaper everywhere.
steps.notice: Meadow Mist now shows a pale green surface here instead of the mountain picture.

steps.path: Projects, Conversations tab, click a conversation
steps.headline: The Projects preview now works like the Resume browser: rename, tags, complete, model choice and Resume.
steps.changed: The name at the top is clickable to rename (dotted underline and pencil). Beside the close button are the tag button (tags and a note) and the Complete check. The bottom card holds the tags, the details line with the date, the model picker, Skip Permissions, Launch in New Window and a Resume Session button. "Resume in Claude" and the date strip under the title are gone.
steps.notice: The model picker starts on the model this conversation last used, same as /resume. Resume closes Projects and opens the conversation with your choices.
steps.risk: The button now reads "Resume Session" (the Resume browser's wording) rather than just "Resume". Say if you want both changed to "Resume".

steps.headline: The line under each card's title is the conversation's first message; the test app now shows a real-looking one.
steps.changed: "Session in youcoded" was made-up text from the test app, not something your real app shows. On your app this line is the first thing you typed in that conversation.
steps.notice: Nothing changes on your real app from this step — only the test pictures.
